content_text:
Hi everybody,
I’m shooting a shot next week where the director wants to track an athlete walking onto the ice and starts to ice-skate. Ideally we are leading our talent frontal and then on the ice, profile 3/4. She won’t go fast, just slow speed for 10 meters until start position for a race. For the moment we are planning for a regular steady stepping up on an iceskating dolly. But we are worried about acceleration.
Any other ideas/ experiences?
Thank you!
